subject: interface
reads: Health, timer and level read at a glance without the eyes leaving the cat. Level-up cards are picked with a thumb. A child reads icons and numbers, never sentences.
camera: Portrait phone, about 7 cm wide, held at arm length. The HUD overlays the game, so every pixel it takes is a pixel of arena the player cannot see.
questions: How much of the screen may the HUD take before it eats the game?
How large is a touch target a child can hit while panicking?
How does a HUD stay readable over a bright moving world?
